name: Romance Detective
source:
Eccentric woman whose mission in life is to solve crimes of passion. [spoiler]Her real name is Rose.
She is very sensitive about her eyes and always keeps them hidden behind sunglasses. [url=https://vndb.org/c17486]Chrys[/url] is the first person she's shown them to in years.[spoiler]
